items.title: Pumpkin Half with Seeds
items.alt: A pumpkin half reveals pale seeds and fibrous orange strands, with a cut wedge resting beside it.
items.description: A pumpkin half reveals pale seeds and fibrous orange strands, with a cut wedge resting beside it. Use this illustration for pumpkin anatomy lessons.

items.title: Sprouting Pumpkin Seed
items.alt: A sprouting pale pumpkin seed has two open green seed leaves and branching ivory roots.
items.description: A sprouting pale pumpkin seed has two open green seed leaves and branching ivory roots. Use this illustration for germination sequence worksheets.

items.title: Moon and Stars Carved Pumpkin
items.alt: An orange pumpkin lantern glows through crescent-moon and star cutouts with its stemmed lid resting beside it.
items.description: An orange pumpkin lantern glows through crescent-moon and star cutouts with its stemmed lid resting beside it. Use this illustration for seasonal craft inspiration.
